items.signal_prefix: nVent completed the previously announced acquisition of Maverick Power

set.signal: nVent completed the previously announced acquisition of Maverick Power, a manufacturer of engineered power distribution and infrastructure solutions for data centers.

items.reason: Depth rule: HQ, ~900 employees, power-distribution platform and new-power-architecture framing (incl. the CEO quote) were already on the node from the 08-24-2026 announcement release; only the completion is new.

items.label: onsemi press release: onsemi and Synaptics Announce Revised Merger Agreement (10-01-2026)
items.signal_prefix: onsemi and Synaptics amended their June 25, 2026 merger agreement

set.signal: onsemi and Synaptics amended their June 25, 2026 merger agreement. The transaction has been approved by the United States Federal Trade Commission, regulators in other jurisdictions are reviewing it, and it is still expected to close by mid-2027, subject to approval by Synaptics shareholders, the receipt of required regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. CEO Hassane El-Khoury: Synaptics complements growth in onsemi's AI data center business and brings its human-machine interface and sensing products businesses; beyond the previously announced $200 million of annual run-rate synergies, onsemi has identified incremental opportunities from revenue synergies and insourcing of a portion of Synaptics' production, expected to be realized after the initial 18 months post-close.

items.reason: Skill 2: deal terms are never captured; drop the all-cash consideration structure and the meta note '(price terms not captured)'; keep the operating facts (FTC approval, close timing, synergies, insourcing).
items.evidence: The transaction is still expected to close by mid-2027, subject to approval by Synaptics shareholders, the receipt of required regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.
